name: frame-shortdrama-agent
description: OHAO monorepo：main 数据与付费主权 · agent 智能能力层 · web/cli 客户端 · shared 公共契约

scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/shared install && npm --prefix packages/agent install && npm --prefix packages/main install && npm --prefix packages/cli install && npm --prefix packages/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix packages/agent run build && npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/cli run build && npm --prefix packages/web run build
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/main test && npm --prefix packages/web test
